headline: RJD Workers Protest Following PM Modi's Nitish Setu Inauguration
seoTitle: RJD Workers Protest PM Modi Nitish Setu Inauguration
metaDescription: RJD supporters tore down promotional posters of PM Modi and the Bihar Chief Minister following the recent inauguration of the Nitish Setu bridge in Vaishali.
aiSummaryBullets: Supporters of the Rashtriya Janata Dal removed and damaged promotional banners of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar.
Protesters stated they were demonstrating against the exclusion of party leader Tejashwi Yadav from the inauguration event of the Nitish Setu.
Bharatiya Janata Party officials condemned the vandalism as an attack on regional development, while RJD members claimed the protesters were local youth.
aiContextParagraph: The inauguration of the Nitish Setu bridge in Vaishali, Bihar, by Prime Minister Narendra Modi has triggered a significant political dispute between the Bharatiya Janata Party and the Rashtriya Janata Dal. Tensions escalated when approximately 100 individuals engaged in protests, tearing down posters featuring the Prime Minister and the Chief Minister of Bihar. RJD supporters cited the exclusion of Tejashwi Yadav from the official proceedings as a primary grievance behind the demonstrations. Meanwhile, the BJP has characterized the actions as an obstruction to regional infrastructure progress and an unacceptable display of political hostility. Beyond the immediate confrontation at the site, the project has also faced scrutiny regarding its naming conventions and credit attribution, with various political voices debating the contributions of state and national leaders to the bridge's construction. The situation remains a central point of contention in Bihar's ongoing political discourse.
whyItIsViral: This story is generating strong viral interest, covered by four independent outlets with high publication velocity following the bridge's controversial opening.
